en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad street lined with large brick and stucco buildings in early 20th‑century architectural style. On the left side are multi‑storey buildings with bay windows, balconies, and a clock on one of the roofs; trees and a low fence line the sidewalk. Further along stands a complex identified as Hospital St. Johannis. People in period clothing walk along the pavement, while horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians move down the road. The caption text in red is printed at the top of the image.
